relight.title: Relight
relight.description: Change the lighting of your photo with AI. The result is added as a new layer.

direction.label: Light direction
direction.diagonalSoon: Diagonal directions are not supported yet

intensity.label: Strength
intensity.hint: Sets the result layer opacity. Changing it later costs no credits.

custom.label: Describe the lighting (optional)
custom.placeholder: e.g. warm sunset light from behind
custom.hint: Overrides the preset, direction and color when filled in.

output.newLayerHint: Keep existing layers, add result on top
output.replaceWarning: The result replaces the image and is at most 512 px.
output.resolutionNote: Relight results are up to 512 px and are scaled to the canvas.
